production.paddon.management.settings.title: Qo‘shimcha sozlamalar
production.paddon.management.free_movement.title: Rulonlarni paddonlar aro erkin boshqarish
production.paddon.management.free_movement.descript: Yoqilganda barcha ishchilar bir-birining rulonlarini paddonlar orasida ko‘chira oladi va bir-birining paddonlarini qulfdan chiqara oladi. Ko‘chirishdan avval ikkala paddonni qulfdan chiqaring. Omborga qabul qilingan mahsulotlar ko‘chirilmaydi.
production.paddon.management.worker_visibility.desc: Yoqilganda rezka ishchilari boshqa ishchilar ochgan paddonlarni ham ko‘radi. O‘chirilganda har bir ishchi faqat o‘zi ochgan paddonlarni ko‘radi.
production.lamination.settings.label_description: Qoldiq kg saqlanganda shu tomonning labelini avtomatik chiqarish.
production.lamination.settings.save_failed: Laminatsiya sozlamasi saqlanmadi. Qayta urinib ko‘ring.
production.qolip.start.settings.title: Bosmachilar qoliplarni skan qilmasdan ish boshlashi
production.qolip.start.settings.description: Yoqilganda mavjud qolip komplekti ish boshlashdan oldin avtomatik tekshiriladi. Peredelkadagi, band yoki biriktirilmagan qoliplar bilan ish boshlanmaydi.

production.paddon.management.free_movement.title: Manage rolls freely between paddons
production.paddon.management.free_movement.descript: When enabled, workers can move each other’s rolls between paddons and unlock each other’s paddons. Unlock both paddons before moving rolls. Goods already received into a warehouse cannot be moved.
production.paddon.management.worker_visibility.titl: Workers can see each other’s paddons
production.paddon.management.worker_visibility.desc: When enabled, cutting workers also see paddons created by other workers. When disabled, each worker sees only their own paddons.
